name: Telegram Torrent Leecher
description: A Telegram Torrent Leecher and ytdl bot based on Pyrogram!

ADMIN_CHATS.description: Chats where this bot will respond and leech

DB_URL.description: MongoDB URL for persistent Bunkr sessions and the optional RSS auto-download feature

LAZYLEECH_DB_NAME.description: MongoDB database name for LazyLeech collections (default: ASWFeed)

BUNKR_SLOW_SPEED_KBPS.description: Bunkr speed threshold in KiB/s for moving a slow file to the bottom (default: 650; 0 disables)

BUNKR_SLOW_GRACE_SECONDS.description: Grace period before monitoring a Bunkr download for slow speed (default: 60)

BUNKR_SLOW_DURATION_SECONDS.description: Continuous slow period before moving a Bunkr file to the bottom (default: 90)

BUNKR_MAX_AUTO_SKIPS.description: Maximum automatic bottom-of-queue moves per Bunkr file (default: 2; 0 disables)

BUNKR_CONNECTIONS.description: Range connections for a fresh Bunkr download (default: 4)

BUNKR_RECOVERY_CONNECTIONS.description: Range connections after a Bunkr file is deferred (default: 1)

BUNKR_MAX_DOWNLOADS_PER_HOST.description: Concurrent Bunkr files allowed per CDN host (default: 4)

BUNKR_SLOW_HOST_COOLDOWN_SECONDS.description: Seconds to deprioritize a slow Bunkr CDN within its session (default: 300)

NYAA_RSS_LINKS.description: Add multiple nyaa links you wish to auto-download animes from, else leave it and will auto-download animes from AWS in all admin chats [Useless if no DB_URL added]

RSS_RECHECK_INTERVAL.description: Add time in minutes, key is self-descriptive, set recheck interval else default is 5 minutes [Useless if no DB_URL added]

BOT_TOKEN.description: Get this from https://t.me/botfather and enable Inline Mode

EVERYONE_CHATS.description: Space-separated chat IDs where everyone (not just admins) can use the bot

MEGADEBRID_TOKEN.description: Mega-Debrid API token (premium account). Optional if you set MEGADEBRID_LOGIN/PASSWORD instead

MEGADEBRID_LOGIN.description: Mega-Debrid account username. Lets the bot fetch/refresh its own token (recommended over MEGADEBRID_TOKEN)

MEGADEBRID_PASSWORD.description: Mega-Debrid account password. Used with MEGADEBRID_LOGIN to fetch/refresh the API token
